feedback.problem:
$$
T=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 3 \\ -2 & 4 & 2\end{aligned}],\,T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}ay+3z-x \\ bz-2x+cy\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the standard matrix $T$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{2}$ shown above. What is the value of $a+b+c?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Given the vector $\,[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]\,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 3 \\ -2 & 4 & 2\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-x+0y+3z \\ -2x+4y+2z\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0y+3z-x \\ 2z-2x+4y\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the linear transformation $T$ is given by

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}0y+3z-x \\ 2z-2x+4y\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, $a+b+c=0+2+4=6.$
